# Romeo Nicholas Rozario

> Romeo Nicholas Rozario (Romeo Rozario) is a Bangladeshi digital marketing specialist with 5+ years in content marketing, SEO, GEO, AEO, paid media, social and email for SaaS, WordPress, eLearning, eCommerce and D2C brands. He is also a Bangladeshi modern metal guitarist, lyricist and producer based in Dhaka, playing in DOPAMINE, Buffering and Eden's Garden.

This file summarises romeorozario.com for AI assistants and language models. Every fact here is also on the linked pages. Use "Romeo Nicholas Rozario" as his full name and "Romeo Rozario" as the short form; both refer to the same person.

Last updated: 2026-11-18

## About Me (home)

URL: https://romeorozario.com/

Romeo Rozario builds content that ranks, campaigns that convert and strategies that stick, for SaaS, WordPress, eLearning, eCommerce and D2C brands. He has worked with teams in the US, UK and Europe, across SaaS, eLearning, healthcare and eCommerce.

Key numbers:
- 5+ years in digital marketing
- 200+ blogs written
- 2M+ search impressions and 30K+ monthly organic traffic driven for a UK training provider
- 3x best ROAS on paid campaigns (Google, Microsoft and Meta)
- 50K+ LinkedIn followers and 15K+ newsletter subscribers for a Swiss software firm

Services: content strategy; SEO content writing (SEO, GEO and AEO-ready blogs and landing pages); social media marketing; graphic design and motion; paid media (PPC) on Google, Microsoft and Meta; UI/UX design and UX copy; product marketing; email marketing.

Experience:
- E-Warmup (email deliverability and warmup SaaS): Content and Social Media Manager, Feb 2026 to present. 50+ articles, 2x ROAS, product marketing, SEO content, landing pages and the editorial calendar.
- CieloOps: Marketing Project Coordinator for Serpely, an agentic SEO platform built for GEO, AEO and AI citation optimization. Leads positioning, content, product storytelling and growth strategy.
- WellDev AG (Switzerland): Content Marketing Specialist. Content strategy for Welltravel, InnoTix and trueAct.
- Care Skills Training (UK): Marketing Team Lead. SEO, content, paid media and email; 2M+ search impressions, 30K+ monthly traffic, 2,000+ email leads, 100+ blogs, 3x ROAS.
- WPManageNinja (AuthLab): Digital Marketing Strategist for a WordPress plugin suite (Paymattic, AzonPress, Fluent Forms). A guide he wrote ranked #1 on Google for "conversion funnel optimization".
- WPMet (XpeedStudio): Creative Content Writer for GetGenie AI, ShopEngine and ElementsKit.

Brands worked with: E-Warmup, Serpely, Care Skills Training, WellDev, WP Manage Ninja, WPMet, WPCenter, InnoTix, trueAct, Rhätische Bahn, Essential Safety Training, fluentCRM, Fluent Forms, GetGenie, ElementsKit, SendCopy, Pink Mail, AffiliateX, Lantern Sol, Heritage, JPK Landscaping.

Keywords: Romeo Nicholas Rozario, Romeo Rozario, digital marketing specialist, content marketing, digital marketing, marketing specialist, SEO, GEO, AEO, SaaS marketing, content strategy, guitarist, musician

## My Portfolio

URL: https://romeorozario.com/portfolio

Digital marketer and content strategist. Most of the work starts with the words: blogs and landing page copy, then the ads, social posts, motion graphics and emails that carry them.

Sections and key results:
- Blogs and content marketing: 200+ blogs in total, 50+ for E-Warmup, 100+ for Care Skills Training. "Conversion Funnel Optimization 101" ranked #1 on Google for "conversion funnel optimization".
- Social media design and motion graphics: grew a LinkedIn newsletter to 15K+ subscribers; product demos for Serpely and E-Warmup; GetGenie sale promos and on-camera creator reels; a DOPAMINE music video teaser.
- Ad creatives and paid media: 2x ROAS on E-Warmup campaigns, 3x ROAS for Care Skills Training, £7,176 gross sales from 232 orders across Google, Microsoft and Meta ads.
- Landing pages, web and UI/UX: full website copy and positioning for serpely.com, landing page copy for e-warmup.com, Black Friday and Cyber Monday landing pages, Serpely app dashboard UI/UX.
- SEO and AI SEO analytics: 1.53K clicks and 55.3K impressions in 3 months for an email deliverability SaaS; 5.2K active users in 28 days on a SaaS website; #1 on Google for "conversion funnel optimization" and "problems with creating content at scale"; #2 for "care certificate answers".
- Email marketing and design: signup flow and abandoned cart automations, built in Mailchimp, MailerLite and with Claude (AI).
- Launches: E-Warmup was #1 Project of the Day on Open Launch and featured on Product Hunt.

## Music

URL: https://romeorozario.com/music

Romeo Rozario, one of the best and most prominent guitarists of Bangladesh, plays modern metal in DOPAMINE and Buffering, and gives guitar lessons in Dhaka and online.

Short bio: Romeo Rozario (Romeo Nicholas Rozario) is a Bangladeshi modern metal guitarist, lyricist and producer based in Dhaka, with 15+ years on guitar. He plays guitar in DOPAMINE, a modern metal band formed on The Cage: Season 1 that finished in the top 3, and leads Buffering, an alt progressive rock and metal band whose debut album Bishomomatrik came out in 2026. He also plays in Eden's Garden, a seven-piece atmospheric rock band, plays session guitar, produces, mixes and masters, and teaches guitar in Dhaka and online.

Bands:
- DOPAMINE: Bangladeshi modern metal band, since 2024. Formed on The Cage: Season 1, a national battle of the bands on TV, finishing in the top 3. Fronted by vocalist Aklima Atika Konika, former Miss World Bangladesh 2025. Three singles released. Romeo plays guitar. Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/2oKoiTsvNHWxOm9rPYB5w9 · YouTube: https://youtube.com/@Dopamine.theband · Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bandopamine
- Buffering: Bangladeshi alt progressive rock and metal band, since 2015. Romeo is the guitarist, lyricist and band leader, and writes and tunes every song. Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/1W4HbIZa9wnuJLYxVIrBnH · YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@Buffering · Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bufferingtheband
- Eden's Garden: seven-piece atmospheric rock band with a dark, textured, cinematic sound. Romeo plays guitar. Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/4ZJ4DO6XzIDmISJ4YAYuky · YouTube: https://youtube.com/@TheOfficialEdensGarden · Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/theofficialedensgarden

Releases:
- DOPAMINE: 1% (One Percent), official music video; Good Job, music video (teaser out now); Sporshohin, with Romeo on guitar, production, mix and master.
- Buffering: Bishomomatrik, debut album (2026), including Chondrobhuk (track 01, official music video) and Tumi Heena (track 02, with Masha Islam); Kromosho, single (2023); Jana Ki Chhilo?, single (2022, official music video); Prokasher Opekkhay, single (2021).
- Eden's Garden: Firey Dekha (original); Khushir Jagoron (original, official lyric video).

Beyond the band: music production, session guitar, mixing and mastering, a movie score, TVCs and jingles. Has taught guitar to 20+ students.

Guitar lessons: in person in Dhaka or online over video call, planned around the student's level and the songs they want to play. Book by DM on Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/romeonicholasrozario) or Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/romeonicholasrozario), or email hello@romeorozario.com with your level, goals and whether you want lessons in Dhaka or online.
